title: 英伟达CEO变动背后 财务安排与收入路径引关注
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I guess for you as an investor, what do you want to see with regards to, I guess, the replacement
segments.zh: 作为市场参与者，你想看到关于接任者的情况是怎样的？

segments.en: of Jensen Wong or do you actually want Jensen Wong to come back?
segments.zh: 还是你其实希望Jensen Wong回来？

segments.en: Well, I think it's going to be very difficult if not impossible for Jensen Wong to come back.
segments.zh: 我认为Jensen Wong要回来即使并非不可能，也会非常困难。

segments.en: He lied to the board. He's going to be an ongoing investigation. There's a new SEC investigation.
segments.zh: 他对董事会撒谎，调查将持续进行，SEC有新的调查。

segments.en: I will say the key number that wasn't touched on that we were focused on was free cash flow conversion, which had really dipped last quarter to 36 percent.
segments.zh: 我要说的是，我们关注但未被提及的关键数字是自由现金流转化率，上季度确实降至36%。

segments.en: It came in around 66, 67 percent for this quarter. So that's a move in the right direction.
segments.zh: 本季度约为66%到67%，所以这是朝着正确方向的变化。

segments.en: The one thing I would keep in mind is the inventory build a little bit on the inventory and the days
segments.zh: 我要记住的一点是库存略有增加，以及客户未付款天数

segments.en: of customer outstanding move from 60 to 64 or 64 days from 60 last quarter and from 45 days
segments.zh: 从60天增加到64天，上季度是60天，再之前是45天。

segments.en: the previous quarter. So the time that the customers are taking to pay is going up. Now, from an investor standpoint, first off, we don't own the stock here. I think the real issue is going to have
segments.zh: 所以客户付款时间在延长。从市场参与者角度看，首先我们并不持有该权益资产。我认为真正的问题将是

segments.en: an outsider come in with a pristine reputation to edify all of these financing commitments because
segments.zh: 由一位声誉卓著的外部人士加入，来澄清所有这些融资承诺，因为

segments.en: up to 25 percent of their revenues next year are companies that either vendor finance or balance sheet backstop. That's a huge portion of revenues as well as the big China rerouting question which
segments.zh: 明年高达25%的收入来自那些提供供应商融资或资产负债表支持的客户。这是收入的很大一部分，也是中国业务调整的大问题。
